description: A wide landscape of steep, dark red mountains with sharp, snow-capped white peaks rising against a flat teal sky. The slopes are rough and speckled with black and brown shadow and crossed by faint ridgelines. Near the right, high on the mountainside, a small dark opening suggests a second cave or doorway. At the foot of the slopes is a round cave mouth ringed with grey stone, and from it a narrow blue stream winds down and out of the picture at the bottom. The foreground is a meadow of mottled green and brown grass. The view is from ground level at a distance, the light is bright daylight, and the mood is rugged and remote. Only the stream moves. Frame 1: the stream's water shows one pattern of ripples. Frame 2: the ripples shift down along its course. Both frames are short and equal, so the loop reads as a steady, quick trickle of water flowing out of the cave.
title: Red mountains with a cave stream
